about_the_game:
Rose Academy is a detective visual novel about a young special agent sent to an elite girls' school to investigate the mysterious death of one of its top students. As you uncover the dark secrets hidden behind the academy’s flawless facade, you'll be drawn into a world of intrigue, temptation, and romance.
🔍 The demo version covers the first day at the Academy, introducing you to all the main characters and the core investigation mechanics.

🔍 The gameplay offers approximately 40 minutes of reading.

🔍 A detective story with a touch of romance: Investigate the crime, flirt with suspects, and make choices—each one may bring you closer to the truth or lead you astray.

🔍 Interactive journal: All collected clues, observations, and suspect information are automatically recorded in a handy journal—your main investigation tool.

🔍 Meaningful dialogue choices: Your words matter. Decide who to question, who to trust, and how to approach each lead.

🔍 Original soundtrack: A rich, atmospheric score enhances the story’s most emotional and suspenseful moments.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains mild suggestive content and themes intended for mature audiences:

Occasional romantic and fanservice scenes, including kissing and implied intimacy. These scenes are not explicit and are described briefly in text.

short_description: In this detective visual novel, you play as a young agent sent to an elite girls' academy to investigate the suspicious death of a top student. Interrogate suspects, collect evidence, and build romantic relationships — will you uncover the truth or fall for someone's charm?
